chaosStar.description: Disaster! You must invoke the runes; runes invoked in this way are destroyed rather than exhausted.

sigmarsComet.description: N Your allies recover both stress and atigue.

conservative.requirements: As part of this action you hold aloft a Rune item and invoke its mystic runes. Effect: You unleash some of the magic contained within the runes. The runes invoked in this way are exhausted (turned facedown) and will recharge with the next sunrise. For each rune exhausted, all allies within medium range recover 1 stress or 1 atigue.

chaosStar.description: Disaster! You must invoke the most possible runes; runes invoked in this way are destroyed rather than exhausted.

sigmarsComet.description: A single critical wound belonging to an ally within medium range with a severity no greater than the number of runes invoked is turned facedown.

reckless.requirements: Effect: You unleash some of the magic contained within the runes. The runes invoked in this way are exhausted (turned facedown) and will recharge with the next sunrise. For each rune exhausted, all allies within medium range recover 1 wound.
